_phase_documentation: Brain Model 0930 defines 3 internal phases that operate WITHIN the configurable sleep window. The window (02:00-07:00) is the outer container; the phases are the internal structure.

phase_1_deep_sleep.name: Slow-Wave Deep Sleep
phase_1_deep_sleep.description: Phoenix Forge smelts accumulated knowledge nodes through JeanGreyClient (Pro). Cheshire Protocol (Flash) parses for patterns and abstract concepts.

phase_2_waking_integration.name: Waking Integration / REM Equivalent
phase_2_waking_integration.description: Cross-domain synthesis. Rodin writes crystallized nodes to The Hoard with CCID stamps. DST-level emergent connections formed.

phase_3_siesta_dreaming.name: Siesta Dreaming / Light Sleep
phase_3_siesta_dreaming.description: Low-intensity associative dreaming. Thought experiments, speculative cross-domain leaps. Only Cheshire Protocol active for rapid ideation.

phoenix_force_override.description: When Operation Phoenix Force is authorized by the Architect, all API timers are overridden. All kernels boot to P0. Duty cycle reinstates when the autonomous task completes.
